name: outage-with-failover
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). The controller is detached from 15 s to 40 s and B stops at 20 s. A fails over to D on its own while the controller is away; its failover report is held at C. After reattachment the replay tells the controller, which confirms the route through D without fighting the node's switch.
